# Larkspur 5.1 Release Notes

Larkspur 5.1 adds shared budgets, CSV import from 12 banks, and a dark mode.

## What's new

Shared budgets: You can now share a budget with up to 6 people, which suits household expenses, trips, or group projects. Everyone sees the same up-to-date numbers.

CSV import: Larkspur now supports CSV import from 12 major banks, so you can load past transactions in a few steps.

Dark mode: Switch to the new dark mode in Settings, or let Larkspur follow your device's appearance. It is easier on the eyes at night.

## Fixes

- Some transactions appeared twice after syncing. This is fixed, so balances and reports should stay accurate.

Larkspur 5.1 is available now.
